findings.message: AC-02 の「actionable diagnostic」は判定条件が定義されておらず、決定論的に検証できません。D1 が要求する「何をプローブしたか」「なぜ失敗したか」「利用者が取れる選択肢」が AC 本文に含まれないため、汎用エラーを表示してリンク作成を避けるだけの実装でも合格し得ます。
`related_conventions` にある `no-upstream-restatement.md` は、自身の Scope で `spec.json` を明示的に適用外とし、impl-plan と型カタログだけを対象としている。この spec に対する規範としては自己明白に無関係なので、参照を削除する必要がある。

`infrastructure::codex_common::resolve_codex_runtime` の `docs` が「repo-local を先に probe し、その後 PATH fallback」という IN-03/CN-02/CN-03 の挙動を再記述しています。`knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md` に従い、変更対象と anchor 参照だけにしてください。
`infrastructure::codex_common::resolve_codex_runtime` は保持しない `project_root` を `PathBuf` で所有権移動させるため、呼び出し側に不要な clone を強制します。read-only resolver の引数は `&std::path::Path` にしてください。

`infrastructure::ResolvedCodexRuntime` の `&self` accessor 4件が `OsString`、`Option<PathBuf>`、`PathBuf`、`String` を所有値で返し、参照だけで足りる利用にも clone/allocation を強制します。各戻り値を `&OsStr`、`Option<&Path>`、`&Path`、`&str` として宣言してください。
`infrastructure::FsCodexRuntimeProvisioner` の `docs` が「解決・probe 後に link を作る」という IN-01/AC-01 の順序契約を再記述しています。`knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md` に従い、変更対象と anchor 参照だけにしてください。

`usecase::CodexRuntimeProvisionPort::provision` は filesystem、npm、subprocess I/O を担う port なのに同期メソッドとして宣言され、`docs` に blocking を選ぶ理由もありません。async 境界にするか、同期実行を意図した契約として明記し、`CodexRuntimeProvisionService` 側も同じ実行色に揃えてください。

The `CodexRuntimeProvisionPort::provision` and `CodexRuntimeProvisionService::provision` declarations take `project_root: std::path::PathBuf` by value even though the operation only needs to use the repository path as a location and the infrastructure resolver already accepts `&std::path::Path`. This needlessly transfers ownership across the usecase boundary and forces callers to clone or relinquish a path; declare a borrowed path (`&std::path::Path`) unless the contract explicitly requires ownership.

`infrastructure::CodexDryChecker` restates upstream design rationale and behavior in `docs` (opaque provider strings, pass-through semantics, and prompt-label treatment) instead of referring to the governing spec anchors. Keep this field as an anchor-based summary only, per `no-upstream-restatement.md`.

`cli::commands::codex_runtime::execute` is declared as `UseCaseFunction`, but `type-designer-kind-selection.md` R1 permits that role only in the usecase layer. This function is a stateless CLI delivery handler that obtains and invokes a driver, so declare it as the CLI-compatible `FreeFunction` role.

`cli::commands::codex_runtime::resolve_provision_project_root` と `CodexRuntimeProvisionArgs::project_root` は、`None` を「プロセス作業ディレクトリから Git root を探索する」という新しい分岐として定義していますが、参照先の IN-01／AC-01／AC-02 は Codex 候補の検証・リンク配備を規定するだけで、この CLI 省略時契約を規定していません。該当する upstream spec 要素で根拠付けるか、未規定の分岐を型契約から除いてください。

`CodexRuntimeCompositionRoot` に `discover_project_root` を追加すると、純粋な DI を担う `CompositionRoot` が外部リポジトリ探索まで実行し、driver 配線と探索という別々の責務を同じ unit struct に束ねます。`type-designer-kind-selection.md` R1 の CompositionRoot 契約に従い、探索は port／adapter 境界へ置き、composition root はそれを配線して返すだけにしてください。

`CodexRuntimeCompositionRoot::discover_project_root` は実際には `CompositionError::Infrastructure` しか生成できないのに、5用途を共有する `CompositionError` を返すため、呼び出し側に `ConfigLoad`、`AdapterInit`、`WiringFailed`、`Usecase` という到達不能な variant まで扱わせます。entry docs に生成可能 subset の記載や共有型を使う根拠もないため、探索専用の精密な error 型を宣言してください。

`cli::commands::codex_runtime::execute` docs restate the upstream dispatch/precedence/rendering behavior instead of referring to the spec anchor; replace the behavioral prose with an anchor-only intent per `no-upstream-restatement.md`.
`CodexRuntimeProvisionArgs` docs restate the optional-root precedence and discovery behavior from the spec; the catalogue should cite the upstream contract rather than reproduce it.
`CodexRuntimeCompositionRoot` docs restate the complete wiring and non-invocation behavior; this is upstream design rationale/contract and should be represented by anchor references only.
`CodexRuntimeDriver` docs restate root precedence, service orchestration, rendering, and dependency-boundary rationale; replace the prose contract with upstream anchor references.
`CodexRuntimeInput` docs restate explicit-vs-discovered root behavior; this duplicates the upstream behavioral contract and should use anchor references instead.

`GitCodexRuntimeProjectRootDiscoveryAdapter` docs restate its failure mapping and injection topology; these are upstream design/behavior details that should be referenced by anchors rather than repeated.
`CodexRuntimeProjectRootDiscoveryPort` docs restate the application-boundary and caller topology; this upstream architecture rationale should not be duplicated in the catalogue docs.
`CodexRuntimeProjectRootDiscoveryService` docs restate boundary leakage prevention, precedence, and rendering behavior belonging to the upstream contract; use anchor references instead.
`CodexRuntimeProjectRootDiscoveryError` docs restate the failure semantics, construction path, propagation, and CLI rendering contract; the catalogue should cite the spec rather than reproduce it.
`CodexRuntimeProjectRootDiscoveryInteractor` docs restate the delegation and sanctioned-boundary rationale from the upstream design; replace this prose with anchor references.
`cli::commands::codex_runtime::execute` の `docs` が引数変換、root を解決しないこと、driver 呼び出し、exit-code 変換という挙動を散文で再記述しています。`no-upstream-restatement.md` に従い、変更対象・操作と IN-06／AC-07 の参照だけにしてください。
`CodexRuntimeProvisionArgs` の `docs` が explicit root の優先と `None` 時の Git-root discovery という IN-06／AC-07 の契約を再記述しています。挙動本文を削除し、anchor 参照に置き換えてください。
`CodexRuntimeCompositionRoot` の `docs` が adapter→interactor→service→driver の完全な配線手順と非実行契約を再記述しています。`no-upstream-restatement.md` に従い、composition 対象と anchor 参照だけにしてください。
`CodexRuntimeDriver` の `docs` が root の優先順位、discovery/provisioning の実行、失敗の rendering、依存境界の理由を再記述しています。これらは IN-06／AC-07 を参照し、catalogue では変更対象と役割だけを記述してください。
`CodexRuntimeInput` の `docs` が `Some` と `None` の優先・discovery 挙動を再記述しています。型の目的と IN-06／AC-07 の anchor 参照だけにしてください。
`GitCodexRuntimeProjectRootDiscoveryAdapter` の `docs` が `SystemGitRepo::discover` の再利用、failure mapping、DiagnosticMessage 構築、injection topology を散文で再記述しています。変更対象と IN-06／AC-07 の参照だけにしてください。
`CodexRuntimeProjectRootDiscoveryPort` の `docs` が current-directory discovery と interactor／driver 間の境界構成を再記述しています。`no-upstream-restatement.md` に従い、port の追加と IN-06／AC-07 の参照だけにしてください。

`CodexRuntimeProjectRootDiscoveryPort::discover` は Git プロセスを伴う外部 I/O port ですが、`is_async: false` であり、entry docs に同期・blocking 境界を選ぶ理由がありません。同期選択を明記するか async 化し、`CodexRuntimeProjectRootDiscoveryService` と実行色を揃えてください。
`CodexRuntimeProjectRootDiscoveryService` の `docs` が SecondaryPort の非漏洩、explicit-over-discovered precedence、CommandOutcome rendering を再記述しています。型の追加と IN-06／AC-07 の参照だけにしてください。
`CodexRuntimeProjectRootDiscoveryError` の `docs` が失敗条件、adapter での構築、service での伝搬、driver での rendering まで再記述しています。挙動本文を upstream anchor 参照に置き換えてください。
`CodexRuntimeProjectRootDiscoveryInteractor` の `docs` が port への委譲と「sanctioned application-service boundary」という設計理由を再記述しています。`no-upstream-restatement.md` に従い、実装対象と IN-06／AC-07 の参照だけにしてください。

`CodexRuntimeProjectRootDiscoveryPort::discover_from` は Git subprocess を実行する外部 I/O port ですが、`is_async: false` であり、entry docs に同期・blocking 境界を選ぶ理由がありません。async 化するか、one-shot の bounded blocking operation として同期実行を選ぶ契約を明記してください。

`handle` can invoke two separate use-case services for one request: it calls `project_root_discovery_service.discover()` and then `service.provision(...)`. The cli_driver policy requires exactly one interactor per request; move root-resolution orchestration into a usecase application service and inject that single service here.
findings.category: handle not delegating to single use case

findings.message: `handle` conditionally invokes the project-root discovery interactor and then invokes the provisioning interactor, so an omitted root causes two use-case calls and runtime branching between interactors in the primary adapter. Move root resolution and provisioning behind one use-case application service and have the driver perform a single invoke→render flow.

findings.message: T001 description restates behavioral rationale: “so bootstrap callers receive actionable provisioning failures through the existing layered boundary.” Keep only target, operation, and anchor cite.

T002 description restates the resolver behavior contract, including link preference, PATH fallback, probing, logging, recovery guidance, and environment inheritance. Keep only target, operation, and anchor cite.

T003 description restates the provisioning behavior contract, including probe sequencing, npm fallback restrictions, atomic linking, and prohibited state changes. Keep only target, operation, and anchor cite.

T004 description restates upstream bootstrap constraints and behavior: generic Makefile wiring, removal of inline resolution, and the integrated regression contract. Keep only target, operation, and anchor cite.

Section S1 description restates the design rationale and behavior contract for typed errors, hexagonal direction, and Makefile-side resolution. Section descriptions should not restate upstream design prose.
Section S2 description restates the resolver behavior contract and enumerates its downstream execution paths. Section descriptions should not restate upstream design prose.
Section S3 description restates the symlink provisioning behavior and prohibited implementation details. Section descriptions should not restate upstream design prose.
Section S4 description restates bootstrap wiring and consumer-test behavior rather than limiting itself to plan organization. Section descriptions should not restate upstream design prose.

The `plan.summary` array is empty even though the upstream spec defines GO-01 and GO-02. Goal mappings are intentionally excluded from `task-coverage.json`, so `impl-plan.json#plan.summary` must provide goal-to-task traceability; currently neither goal is mapped.

T001 は `CodexRuntimeCompositionRoot` を実装対象に含みますが、この root が配線する `FsCodexRuntimeProvisioner` は後続の T003 に帰属しています。一方、T003 は T001 が追加する `CodexRuntimeProvisionPort` に依存するため、現状は相互依存となり、どちらも個別にコンパイル可能な commit にできません。composition root とその task-contract attribution を T003、または T003 後の新規 task へ移してください。

T001 description includes an upstream behavior-contract restatement: “An explicit project root takes precedence; otherwise the driver requests Git-root discovery and reports discovery failure as a typed CommandOutcome.” Keep only target + operation + anchor cite; cite knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md.

Section S1 description restates the upstream behavior contract (“explicit-root precedence and typed Git-root discovery failure”). Remove that rationale/behavior prose and retain target + operation + anchor cites; cite knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md.

T001’s description names only the project-root discovery port (and generic error types), but its contract also attributes `CodexRuntimeProjectRootDiscoveryInteractor` and `CodexRuntimeProjectRootDiscoveryService`. Those catalogue symbols are outside the task boundary as currently described. Name the discovery service and interactor in T001 so the executable task and its attributions agree.

T001 restates upstream behavior-contract prose: “Cover explicit project-root precedence, subdirectory Git-root discovery, typed discovery failure, and the provisioning command path.” Retain target + operation + anchor cites only; cite knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md.

T001 claims to implement CodexRuntimeProjectRootDiscoveryInteractor and CodexRuntimeProjectRootDiscoveryService, but task-contract.json does not attribute either catalogue entry to T001. Add those task attributions or remove the claimed symbols from T001.

`discover()` has no starting-directory input, so the usecase depends on ambient process state: its sole production adapter reads the process-wide current directory and spawns Git through `SystemGitRepo::discover()`. Documenting that dependency does not satisfy the scope policy requiring runtime values to enter through usecase parameters; concurrent `chdir` activity can also select the wrong repository. Accept a starting path on the service/port and use `discover_from`, or resolve the root at the CLI boundary and pass it in.

`CodexRuntimeCompositionRoot::provision` immediately calls `CodexRuntimeDriver::handle(input)` and returns its `CommandOutcome`. This starts the invoke/render flow inside `cli_composition`, although `CompositionRoot` is pure DI and should return the wired driver for `apps/cli` to invoke. Return `CodexRuntimeDriver` from the composition root and move `.handle(input)` to the CLI command handler.

`CodexRuntimeCompositionRoot` no longer implements the catalogue-defined public `provision(input: CodexRuntimeInput) -> CommandOutcome` method; it exposes `codex_runtime_driver()` instead. This breaks the declared composition-root API and any callers generated or wired against the catalogue signature.

`discover_project_root` assembles the user-facing diagnostic `cannot discover git repository root: …` inside the composition root. That text is surfaced by the CLI, so this is a render leak; propagate the typed infrastructure failure without presentation wording and let the primary adapter render the diagnostic.
The focused composition test constructs `CodexRuntimeInput` without the required `invocation_directory` field, so `cli_composition` fails to compile after the driver input contract changed.
The focused composition test constructs `CodexRuntimeInput` without the required `invocation_directory` field, so this crate's tests do not compile against the current driver input type.

`--project-root` が省略された場合のリポジトリルート解決、失敗分岐、診断出力を Driver 呼び出し前に行っており、bin が parse→dispatch→emit を超える複数段のオーケストレーションとアプリケーション I/O を担っています。`.harness/custom/review-prompts/cli.md` の thin-bin 規約に反します。`architecture-rules.json` の依存境界、および `type-designer-kind-selection.md` R1（CompositionRoot は純粋な DI、PrimaryAdapter は invoke+render）に従い、optional root の解決を cli_driver/usecase/infrastructure 側へ移し、bin は typed Input を `driver.handle` に渡して `CommandOutcome` を emit するだけにしてください。

本番ハンドラが `std::env::current_dir()` で実行ディレクトリを取得し、その成否を分岐してから Driver を呼んでいます。これは引数の parse→typed Input→`driver.handle`→emit を超えるアプリケーション入力の解決であり、失敗時には Driver の `CommandOutcome` も迂回します。`architecture-rules.json` の CLI 配送境界と `type-designer-kind-selection.md` R1（CompositionRoot は純 DI、PrimaryAdapter の invoke+render は cli_driver）に従い、bin は `project_root` のみを渡し、実行ディレクトリの取得と失敗の outcome 化を Driver の背後へ移してください。

`refresh_link` constructs `.harness/tools/bin/codex` and calls `create_dir_all`/`rename` without canonicalizing the parent and verifying it remains under `project_root`. If `.harness`, `tools`, or `bin` is a symlink to an external directory, bootstrap writes the runtime link outside the trusted repository root. Add a fail-closed trusted-root check before creating or replacing the link.

`refresh_link` joins the repository root with `.harness/tools/bin/codex` and writes via `create_dir_all`/`rename` without verifying the resolved parent remains under the trusted project root. A symlinked `.harness`, `tools`, or `bin` directory can redirect provisioning outside the repository. Add a fail-closed trusted-root check before writing.

The trusted-root checks precede `rename`, but the parent path is resolved again only before the final filesystem operation. An attacker able to replace a checked ancestor directory with a symlink in the intervening window can still redirect the atomic rename outside `trusted_root`; use directory-handle-relative operations or otherwise close this TOCTOU gap.

`resolve_codex_runtime` runs every candidate's `--version` probe with `Command::output()`, which has neither a deadline nor stdout/stderr limits. A broken or malicious repository-link/PATH executable can therefore hang every Codex workflow indefinitely or exhaust memory before the adapter's configured child timeout begins. Run this short probe through a bounded-output helper with a fixed deadline and map failures to `ProbeFailed`.

The `npm prefix -g` fallback uses unbounded `Command::output()`. A stalled or noisy npm executable can hang bootstrap or consume unbounded memory instead of returning `NpmQueryFailed`; apply a short timeout and strict stdout/stderr caps.

The sanitized candidate probe also uses unbounded `Command::output()`. A candidate that never exits or emits unlimited output can block/OOM bootstrap before it reaches the typed failure path. Use the bounded subprocess runner with a short probe deadline and output limit.

Capability execution performs a second unbounded `codex --version` call solely to populate the session-log header. This happens before the provider process and outside its request timeout, so a changed or stalled executable can prevent dispatch indefinitely. Reuse the already-resolved runtime metadata or run the logging probe with bounded output and a deadline.

The new ref-verifier session log writes all of `stderr_text`, which is populated by the unbounded `spawn_read_to_string` collector. A noisy or malicious Codex process can therefore grow memory and the persistent log without limit. Drain stderr with a fixed-size retained buffer and cap the session log, as the other Codex adapters do.

`prepare_runtime_dir` validates each component with `symlink_metadata`, then performs `current.join(name)`/`create_dir` and later `canonicalize` by pathname. An attacker can replace a checked parent directory with a symlink between these operations, causing runtime creation or log/output access to escape `repo_root`; use directory-handle-relative operations (`openat`/`mkdirat`/`symlinkat`/`renameat` style) and fail closed.

`prepare_runtime_dir` lexically removes `..` components before its handle-relative walk. A runtime path such as `repo/link/../runtime`, where `link` is a symlink, therefore bypasses symlink rejection; the Codex adapter still passes the original joined output path to the child, which can resolve it outside the trusted repository and write there. Preserve fail-closed raw-component validation before normalization (as in `normalize_path_rejecting_symlinked_components` and the `is_safe_briefing_path` traversal policy), then perform the openat walk.

The provider-controlled output leaf is opened with blocking `RDONLY` before its file type is checked. If the child replaces the initialized file with a FIFO, `openat` waits indefinitely after the child has exited, outside the provider timeout. Open with `O_NONBLOCK` and then reject non-regular files via the handle metadata.

The raw traversal check still permits `ordinary/../runtime` when `ordinary` is not a symlink at validation time. That component can be replaced with a symlink immediately afterward; normalization erases it from the handle-relative walk, while Codex still receives the original path in `--output-last-message`, allowing the output write to resolve outside `repo_root`. Follow the fail-closed `is_safe_briefing_path` precedent by rejecting every `ParentDir` component before normalization, rather than relying on a raceable `symlink_metadata` snapshot.

The repository-local Codex link is canonicalized and checked for executability, but the child is later probed/spawned through the mutable symlink path (`link`). A concurrent replacement can make the executed binary differ from the verified `real_path`, allowing an untrusted target to run. Use directory-handle-relative operations (`openat`/`symlinkat`/`renameat`) or otherwise bind verification and execution to the same filesystem object.

`read_dry_fix_last_message_tail` checks the path with `reject_symlinks_below`/`symlink_metadata`, then reopens it by pathname. An attacker can replace the regular file with a symlink between the check and `File::open`, causing the adapter to follow the symlink and read outside the intended runtime path. Use directory-handle-relative/openat-style operations (or equivalent no-follow semantics) for the final open.

`O_NOFOLLOW` on this `openat(CWD, parent, ...)` rejects only a symlink in the final component. After `reject_symlinks_below` returns, the spawned fixer can replace an earlier component such as `tmp` with a symlink; this call follows it, and the subsequent dirfd-relative leaf open can read outside the intended runtime directory. Pin the trusted repository root and walk every parent component with dirfd-relative `openat(..., O_NOFOLLOW | O_DIRECTORY)`, as `prepare_runtime_dir` does.

The fixer can replace its output-last-message file with a FIFO before exiting. This blocking `openat(..., RDONLY)` then waits indefinitely for a writer, so the later `metadata().is_file()` rejection is never reached and `dry fix-local` hangs. Open the leaf with `NONBLOCK` (and preferably `CLOEXEC`) before validating its type, matching `capability_exec/process/runtime_dir.rs`, and add a FIFO regression test.

`canonicalize` plus lexical `join` does not make the runtime directory safe: `create_dir_all` follows an existing symlink in `tmp` or `tmp/reviewer-runtime`, and the returned path is immediately opened by `std::fs::write` at mod.rs:156. Consequently, last-message initialization and the child output can occur outside `trusted_root` before the new safe read detects anything, contrary to the fail-closed symlink policy exercised by `scope_config_loader.rs`. Walk/create each runtime-directory component from a pinned root dirfd using `mkdirat`/`openat(..., NOFOLLOW)`, and create the leaf relative to that handle.

The verified `log_file` dirfd is retained but discarded for the actual post-child write: `write_dry_fix_log(&log_path, ...)` reopens the pathname with `std::fs::write`. While running, the sandboxed fixer can replace the pre-created log leaf with a symlink to any file writable by the unsandboxed parent; this call then overwrites that file outside `trusted_root` with child-influenced output. Keep and write through the original leaf handle, or reopen via `log_file.parent`/`name` using `openat(..., NOFOLLOW)` and verify it remains a regular file.

`discover()` delegates to `SystemGitRepo::discover()`, whose `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` call uses `Command::output()` without a timeout or output cap. Since `git` is resolved from the caller's PATH, a stalled or output-spamming executable can hang provisioning indefinitely or exhaust memory. Use the bounded process runner or add equivalent limits.
